text: Got a second hand mechanical keyboard, bought it for $38 so wasn’t expecting perfection, and that is pretty much what I got. It arrived reasonably clean, and it worked right away, which was a relief. The typing feel is actually better than I expected. I write long emails for work, and the keys are comfortable enough that my hands don’t feel tired after an hour or two. The space bar rattles noticeably if I hit it near the edges. Makes it sound cheaper than it feels. Also, one key occasionally repeats. Annoying when you type fast and have to go back and delete the extra letter. Doesn’t happen constantly, but enough to mention. I did ask the seller about the switches, and she answered my question, but it took a full week to get a reply. By then I’d figured it out. I considered returning it, but for $38, didn’t seem worth the trouble of shipping it back. Overall, I kept it. It’s comfortable and usable, just not flawless.
